lines: Version drift: appinfo/info.xml says 1.2.10, package.json says 0.1.0.
The App Store and the server read info.xml; everything on the node side reads package.json. Whichever is behind, a release ends up carrying two version numbers, and only one of them reaches the user.
The release is built on one of them and a contributor may build on another; a different major gets a different lockfile and, with a native dependency, a different build.
scripts/ is read at run time and is not in the shipped file set: lib/Service/TokenRegistry.php:72 reaches it through __DIR__.

A release ships only the paths of the keep set (the ncmake core and ncmake.mk), so the tarball lacks it and the app fails in the code that reads it, while the build and the packing pass. In ncmake.mk, keep_extra += scripts ships it.
Tooling in the checkout: Stylelint (stylelint.config.js), Psalm (psalm.xml), PHPUnit (phpunit.xml), PHP-CS-Fixer (.php-cs-fixer.dist.php), REUSE (REUSE.toml), EditorConfig (.editorconfig).
No ESLint configuration: nothing checks the frontend sources, so a wrong import is found by the build or not at all.
1 declared package is named nowhere in the checkout: stylelint-config-standard.

Searched as literal names over 1,111 files, package.json excluded apart from its non-dependency fields, lockfiles excluded; then as an ESLint shorthand, as what TypeScript takes from a tsconfig, and as a peer of an installed package in package-lock.json. A package loaded some other way is not named anywhere either, so this is a list to check, not a list to remove.
appinfo/info.xml links its repository and its bug tracker.
Declares Nextcloud 32 to 35; the oldest maintained major is 32 (as of 2026-09), the newest released 35 (the release tags of nextcloud/server).
PHP 8.3 is the floor in appinfo/info.xml and in composer.json, platform 8.3.
package-lock.json (lockfileVersion 3) and composer.lock in the checkout.
The ncmake bootstrap stub is in place (21 lines).
Licence EUPL-1.2 (appinfo/info.xml, package.json, composer.json), LICENSES/ holds AGPL-3.0-or-later.txt, EUPL-1.2.txt, MIT.txt, etalab-2.0.txt.
